rows.zh: 罗宾。

phrases.text: Robin.

parts: Oh, Robin! Hey, yeah, I, uh, guess you never showed up, did you?
rows.zh: 哦，罗宾！对，你昨天好像没来，是吧？

phrases.text: Oh, Robin! Hey, yeah, I, uh, guess you never showed up, did you?

parts: No, I got stuck at work.
But they finally got that kid out of the crane machine.
rows.zh: 对，我工作脱不开身。不过，他们总算把那小孩从抓娃娃机里弄出来了。

phrases.text: No, I got stuck at work.
But they finally got that kid out of the crane machine.

parts: Did he get to keep the purple giraffe?
rows.zh: 那个紫色长颈鹿最后归他了吗？

phrases.text: Did he get to keep the purple giraffe?

parts: Yeah, they let him keep all the toys.
He was in there a long time,
and little kids have small bladders.
rows.zh: 对，他们让他把所有玩具都带走了。他在里面待太久，小孩子又憋不住尿。

phrases.text: Yeah, they let him keep all the toys.

and little kids have small bladders.

parts: I wish your party was tonight.
rows.zh: 要是你的派对在今晚就好了。

phrases.text: I wish your party was tonight.

parts: It is. The party's tonight.
rows.zh: 就是今晚，派对就在今晚。

phrases.text: It is. The party's tonight.

parts: Yeah, uh, it's a two-day party, 'cause that's just how we roll.
rows.zh: 对，这是个连办两天的派对，我们一向就这么玩。（that’s how we roll：我们一向就这么做。）

phrases.text: Yeah, uh, it's a two-day party, 'cause that's just how we roll.

parts: Uh, so if you wanna swing by, you know, it's casual. See ya.
rows.zh: 所以你要是想过来，随意就好。回见。

phrases.text: Uh, so if you wanna swing by, you know, it's casual. See ya.

parts: So that was Robin.
rows.zh: 刚才是罗宾。

phrases.text: So that was Robin.

parts: What are you doing to me, man?
I got a paper to write! I know. I'm sorry. It's terrible.
rows.zh: 兄弟，你这是要整死我吗？我还得写论文呢！我知道，对不起，太糟糕了。

phrases.text: What are you doing to me, man?

parts: I'll buy more dip! Ted! Ted, wait!
rows.zh: 我再去买点蘸酱！泰德，等等！
